name: bitg
title: bitg
description: Convert Uzbek text from old Latin and Cyrillic to the 2026 Latin alphabet (ö ğ ş ç), offline.
author: nosirbek_xakimov

commands.name: convert-selected-text
commands.title: Convert Selected Text
commands.subtitle: bitg
commands.description: Replace the selected text with the same text in the 2026 Uzbek Latin alphabet.

commands.name: convert-clipboard
commands.title: Convert Clipboard Text
commands.subtitle: bitg
commands.description: Convert the text on the clipboard to the 2026 Uzbek Latin alphabet and copy the result.

commands.name: convert-text
commands.title: Convert Text
commands.subtitle: bitg
commands.description: Type or paste Uzbek text and see it in the new Latin, old Latin and Cyrillic alphabets.

preferences.name: keepEnglish
preferences.title: Words
preferences.label: Keep English words
preferences.description: Leave English words such as push or meeting unchanged.

preferences.name: convertCyrillic
preferences.label: Convert Cyrillic
preferences.description: Convert Uzbek Cyrillic text as well as old Latin.

preferences.name: asciiApostrophe
preferences.label: Use ASCII apostrophe
preferences.description: Write the glottal stop as ' instead of ʼ (U+02BC).

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
